title: Spanish Roasted Nectarine and Patata Tart
description: A sweet and savory tart featuring roasted nectarines and patatas, topped with a spicy bravas sauce, perfect for a warm summer evening.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it on a baking sheet.
Brush the crust with olive oil and sprinkle with sugar.
Arrange the sliced patatas on the crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the patatas with sliced nectarines.
Drizzle the bravas sauce over the nectarines.
Fold the edges of the crust up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is tender.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
